items.title: More control over permissions in Bitbucket Pipelines: new features and upcoming changes
items.summary: Automating releases, semantic version bumps, and API calls often involves configuring branch permissions and storing long-lived credentials in pipeline variables. Managing credential rotation adds an ongoing maintenance burden.
